info.title: SofaScore Scraper API
info.description: Versioned HTTP API of the SofaScore scraper. Single resources are returned as {"data": {...}}, collections as {"data": [...], "page": {"limit", "next_cursor"}}, errors as {"error": {"code", "message", "details", "request_id"}}. Messages are English; clients translate by code. When an access token is configured, every request needs Authorization: Bearer <token> or the session cookie.

get.description: The server is up; whether SofaScore answers it; the request budget.

Service state: versions, access to SofaScore, the request budget, the job that is running now, the live
service, what the data directory holds, the leases held right now and the optional features. When the
data directory cannot be read, `live` and `summary` are null and `storage_error` has the error code.

post.description:
Send one request to SofaScore now (the live list of football) and report whether it was answered. Only
called when the user asks; it takes a turn of the shared request budget. A failed check answers 200 with
`ok: false` and the `reason`: blocked, browser, rate_limited, network or upstream.

get.description: The registered sports, in registry order, each with the detail slices that apply to it.

The sinks of the configuration (config file `[[sink]]` or SOFASCORE_SINKS), in their order, with the
position each has delivered up to and how far it lags behind the event log. Sinks are configured in the
file only; this route only reads. Credentials in webhook addresses are masked. Whether a process
delivers right now is `served` (the holder of the `sinks` lease is in `/status` `leases`).
Whether an access token is required and whether this caller presents it. Answers without a token.

post.summary: Sign in with the access token
post.description:
Exchange the access token for a session cookie (HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict). Without a configured token the
call does nothing and reports `authenticated`. A wrong token is 401 `unauthorized` with
`details.reason = "invalid_token"`; after repeated wrong tokens from one address the attempts are refused
for a while (401 with `details.reason = "too_many_attempts"` and `Retry-After`), the right token included.
Delete the session cookie of this browser.

Add a follow and return it (201, with `Location`). A tournament follow is written to config/leagues.txt when
no config file is in use (then only `name` and `sport` can be set), else to the follows table. A follow of a
team, a player or an event is always kept in the follows table. 409 `follow_exists` for an entity or a
tournament name that is followed already.

post.description:
Look the text up on SofaScore (one request, the shared request budget), at most 20 tournaments. An empty
list: SofaScore answered and found nothing. 503 `blocked` / `rate_limited` and 502 `upstream_error` when it
did not answer; `details.reason` is blocked, browser, rate_limited, network or upstream. POST, because every
call sends a request to SofaScore (a GET could be triggered by another site).

The event's stored odds slices (the `odds` group of the slice registry: `odds_all`, `odds_featured`,

odds of this kind are stored; 404 for another slice name.

post.description:
Start a job in the background and return it at once (202). Only one job writes to a data directory at a
time: while another job or a data operation runs, in this server or in another process, the request is
refused with 409 and the holder in `details`. `clear`, `rebuild` and a real `restore` take the data
directory for themselves (no download, live service or other data operation may run). A `clear` needs
`confirm: true` (400 `confirmation_required`). `restore` checks by default (`dry_run: true`); with
`dry_run: false` it restores, and into a data directory that is not empty only with `force: true` (else 400
`confirmation_required` with `details.occupied`). A Parquet export without pyarrow on the server is 501.
A `sync` with `only: "seasons"` reads season lists only; `follows` names the follows to sync; a `fetch` with
`event_ids` fetches events without their tournament, and a `refresh` with `event_ids` reads those events again.

get.description: One job, whichever process runs or ran it.

post.description:
Ask a running job to stop. The process that runs it sees the request within a second; the job then ends
as `cancelled`. A job that has already ended is returned unchanged.

get.summary: Follow the events of a job (SSE)
get.description:
The job's own event log as server-sent events: everything that is retained (the newest 2,000 events per
job), then new events until the job ends. A comment line is sent every 15 seconds. The stream also ends
when the server shuts down.

parameters.name: after

schema.description: Send only events with a sequence number above this.
schema.title: After

parameters.description: Send only events with a sequence number above this.

parameters.name: last-event-id

schema.description: Resume after this event; wins over `after`.
schema.title: Last-Event-Id

parameters.description: Resume after this event; wins over `after`.

200.description: A `text/event-stream`. Each message has `id: <seq>`, `event: <type>` and `data: <JobEvent>`; types are started, phase, progress, log, failed, breaker, cancel_requested and finished. The stream ends after the job's last event. When the requested position is older than the retained events, one `stream.gap` event with `oldest_seq` is sent and the stream ends.

get.description: Every setting with its value, the layer it comes from and whether it can be changed here.

patch.description:
Change settings and return all of them. The request is applied as a whole or not at all. A key that is
pinned by the config file, the environment or a flag is refused (`details.locked`), as is a key that
cannot be changed through the API (`details.read_only`). Changing `storage.data_dir` is refused while a
job runs; downloads and the job history then use the new folder, and files are not moved.

from.description: At or after; ISO 8601 date or date-time (UTC without an offset). The start of the event; for the changes dataset the time the change was recorded. Not for the legacy-wide-csv profile.

to.title: To
to.description: At or before, as `from`; a date includes the whole day.

ExportFilter.title: ExportFilter
ExportFilter.description:
Which records to export; the fields are combined with AND, an empty field filters nothing. The meaning is that
of the filters of `GET /events` (and of `GET /changes` for the changes dataset).

ExportJobSpec.title: ExportJobSpec
ExportJobSpec.description:
What to export. Schema `normalized`: the records of data schema v1 (`events`, `slices`, `changes`, `odds`: one
row per outcome of each odds snapshot, `standings`: the standings rows of the matched events' seasons) as JSONL
(one record per line), CSV, Parquet or SQLite (one column per leaf field, named by its path joined with `_`;
lists as JSON text). Parquet needs the optional package pyarrow on the server (501 `not_supported` without
it). Schema `raw`: the stored payloads as JSONL (dataset `events`: the event payload only, `slices`: every
slice). The profile `legacy-wide-csv` is 2.x's wide CSV (dataset `events`, format `csv`).

id.title: Id
id.description: Id of the export, the id of its job.

state.description: State of the job; the file can be downloaded when `succeeded`.

rows.title: Rows
rows.description: Records (rows or lines) written; for a raw export the payloads written.

events.title: Events
events.description: Events with at least one exported payload.

skipped.title: Skipped
skipped.description: Payloads that could not be read and were left out.

file.title: File
file.description: File name in the data directory's `exports/`.

schema_version.title: Schema Version
schema_version.description: Version of the data schema of the records; null for a raw export and for the legacy-wide-csv profile.

ExportRecord.title: ExportRecord
ExportRecord.description: An export: the job that writes it and, once it has succeeded, its file.

home.title: Home
home.description: Headline score of the home side; SofaScore gives none for a fight, so null.

away.title: Away
away.description: Headline score of the away side; SofaScore gives none for a fight, so null.

method.title: Method
method.description: How the fight was decided, as SofaScore abbreviates it, for example `UD` (unanimous decision), `SD` (split decision), `TKO`, `SUB` (submission); text, not an enumeration of the platform. Null while undecided.

final_round.title: Final Round
final_round.description: The round in which the fight ended. Null while undecided.

FightScore.title: FightScore
FightScore.description: Score family `fight`: no score; how the fight was decided and in which round (MMA). The winner is the event's `winner`.

slices.title: Slices
slices.description: Data selection (slice keys or groups, see GET /sports/{slug}): null = the defaults (`defaults.slices` and `slices.<sport>` of GET /settings); `{"include": [...]}` = only these; `{"enable": [...], "disable": [...]}` = changes to the defaults. What is not selected is never fetched. Not available for a follow kept in config/leagues.txt (no config file).

FollowCreate.title: FollowCreate
FollowCreate.description: A new follow. Without a config file a tournament follow is written to config/leagues.txt (name and sport).

slices.title: Slices
slices.description: Data selection (slice keys or groups, see GET /sports/{slug}): null = the defaults (`defaults.slices` and `slices.<sport>` of GET /settings); `{"include": [...]}` = only these; `{"enable": [...], "disable": [...]}` = changes to the defaults. What is not selected is never fetched.

FollowPatch.title: FollowPatch
FollowPatch.description:
Fields to change; a field left out stays. `sport: null` clears the stored sport, `slices: null` returns to
the defaults.

entity_id.title: Entity Id
entity_id.description: SofaScore's id of the followed entity.

sport.title: Sport
sport.description: Stored sport, else (tournaments) the one its events show.

seasons.title: Seasons
seasons.description: `all`, `current`, `last:N` or a list of season ids.

slices.title: Slices
slices.description: Data selection (slice keys or groups, see GET /sports/{slug}): null = the defaults (`defaults.slices` and `slices.<sport>` of GET /settings); `{"include": [...]}` = only these; `{"enable": [...], "disable": [...]}` = changes to the defaults. What is not selected is never fetched.

live.title: Live
live.description: The live service watches it (`ssc watch`).

origin.title: Origin
origin.description: legacy: config/leagues.txt; config: the config file (read-only here); api: added here.

writable.title: Writable
writable.description: Fields PATCH can change on this follow.

FollowRecord.title: FollowRecord
FollowRecord.description: Something the platform downloads and watches: a tournament, a team, a player or one event.

home.title: Home
home.description: Headline score of the home side: goals including extra time, without the penalty shoot-out.

away.title: Away
away.description: Headline score of the away side: goals including extra time, without the penalty shoot-out.

after_extra_time.description: Goals after extra time (cumulative, without the shoot-out). Null unless the match went to extra time.

penalties.description: Goals of the penalty shoot-out alone.

FootballScore.title: FootballScore
FootballScore.description: Score family `football`: goals by stage of the match.

number.title: Number
number.description: Number of the inning, starting at 1; extra innings go on after 9.

home.title: Home
home.description: Runs of the home side in the inning.

away.title: Away
away.description: Runs of the away side in the inning.

home.title: Home
home.description: Headline score of the home side: runs, extra innings included.

away.title: Away
away.description: Headline score of the away side: runs, extra innings included.

innings.title: Innings
innings.description: Runs of each inning that has a score, in order. SofaScore gives the innings in `innings`; some leagues also give them as `period1` to `period9`, with the same values. An inning missing from `innings` is read from `periodN`.

regulation.description: Runs after the scheduled innings. Null when SofaScore does not give it.

extra_innings.description: Runs scored in extra innings alone. Null without extra innings.

hits.description: Hits of each side in the whole game.

errors.description: Errors of each side in the whole game.

InningsScore.title: InningsScore
InningsScore.description: Score family `innings`: runs by inning, with hits and errors (baseball).

spec.title: Spec
spec.description: The service spec the job was started with.

progress.title: Progress
progress.description: Phase, counters and failed items; the last progress event for a job of another process.

heartbeat_at.title: Heartbeat At
heartbeat_at.description: Epoch milliseconds; written every 5 s while running.

Job.title: Job
Job.description: A job: a download, a refresh or a data operation, started by any face in any process.

code.title: Code
code.description: A code of the error table, e.g. blocked, rate_limited, storage_error.

JobError.title: JobError
JobError.description: The error that stopped the job, or made it partial.

JobKind.title: JobKind
JobKind.description: İşin ne yaptığı. Bugünkü web işi `FETCH` türündedir.

JobSelection.title: JobSelection
JobSelection.description: One followed tournament and, optionally, the seasons or events of it to work on.

JobState.title: JobState
JobState.description: İşin durumu. `QUEUED` ve `RUNNING` dışındakiler son durumdur.

name.title: Name
name.description: writer, live, sinks, maintenance or watcher:<sport>.

LeaseHolder.title: LeaseHolder
LeaseHolder.description: A lease of the data directory that is held right now.

running.title: Running
running.description: A live service holds the `live` lease right now, in any process.

source.title: Source
source.description: page, direct or poll; null when not running.

sports.title: Sports
sports.description: The sports it watches; empty when not running.

heartbeat_at.title: Heartbeat At
heartbeat_at.description: Epoch seconds of the last heartbeat, also of a run that has ended.

blocked.title: Blocked
blocked.description: SofaScore refuses the service right now.

leaders.title: Leaders
leaders.description: Sport to the source that leads it now (page, direct or poll).

last_switch.title: Last Switch
last_switch.description: The last change of a leading source.

LiveStatus.title: LiveStatus
LiveStatus.description: The live service of the data directory (`ssc watch`): its state only, never live data.

message.title: Message
message.description: With secrets masked; a traceback follows its line.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: False when file logging is off; `entries` is then empty.

level.title: Level
level.description: The level the server logs at.

LogTail.title: LogTail
LogTail.description: The newest entries of the log file, oldest first.

key.title: Key
key.description: Odds slice the record comes from: `odds_all` or `odds_featured`.

provider_id.title: Provider Id
provider_id.description: SofaScore's id of the bookmaker the odds come from. Which bookmakers SofaScore offers depends on the country it sees the request from; the platform stores no address or location of the machine.

fetched_at_utc.title: Fetched At Utc
fetched_at_utc.description: When the odds were read. A read is a snapshot: odds change until the event ends, and only a later read shows a later price.

Odds.title: Odds
Odds.description: The odds of an event from one provider as read at one moment.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the outcome as SofaScore gives it, for example `1`, `X`, `2`, `Over`.

fractional.title: Fractional
fractional.description: Current price as a fraction, for example `11/5`.

decimal.title: Decimal
decimal.description: Current price as a decimal (1 + the fraction), rounded to three places.

initial_decimal.title: Initial Decimal
initial_decimal.description: Opening price as a decimal, rounded to three places.

change.title: Change
change.description: Direction of the last change of the price: 1 up, -1 down, 0 none.

winning.title: Winning
winning.description: True for the outcome that won once the event is settled; null while open or when SofaScore does not say.

OddsChoice.title: OddsChoice
OddsChoice.description: One outcome of a betting market and its price.

market_id.title: Market Id
market_id.description: SofaScore's id of the market type (1 is the match result).

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the market, for example `Full time`.

group.title: Group
group.description: Group of the market, for example `1X2` or `Home/Away`.

period.title: Period
period.description: Part of the event the market covers, for example `Full-time`.

choice_group.title: Choice Group
choice_group.description: Line of a market with several lines, for example `2.5` for over/under; null for a market with one line.

label.title: Label
label.description: Name under which the featured odds list the market (`default`, `fullTime`, `asian`); null in the full list.

is_live.title: Is Live
is_live.description: True when the prices were offered during play.

suspended.title: Suspended
suspended.description: True when the market was closed for bets at the time of the read.

choices.title: Choices
choices.description: The outcomes of the market, in SofaScore's order.

OddsMarket.title: OddsMarket
OddsMarket.description: One betting market of an event with its outcomes.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of items in this page.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; null on the last page.

PageInfo.title: PageInfo
PageInfo.description: Cursor pagination of a collection response.

number.title: Number
number.description: Position of the period within the format, starting at 1: quarter 1 to 4, half 1 to 2, or period 1 to 3.

home.title: Home
home.description: Points of the home side in the period (goals in the goal sports).

away.title: Away
away.description: Points of the away side in the period (goals in the goal sports).

home.title: Home
home.description: Headline score of the home side: points including overtime.

away.title: Away
away.description: Headline score of the away side: points including overtime.

format.title: Format
format.description: How regulation time is divided. Null while no period score exists.

periods.title: Periods
periods.description: Points of each period of regulation time that has a score, in order.

regulation.description: Points at the end of regulation time.

overtime.description: Points scored in overtime alone. Null without overtime.

penalties.description: Goals of the penalty shoot-out alone. Null without a shoot-out, and always null for basketball. In the one recorded handball shoot-out, `final` and the headline score include these goals.

PeriodsScore.title: PeriodsScore
PeriodsScore.description: Score family `periods`: points by period (basketball, American football, Aussie rules, ice hockey, handball, rugby, futsal, minifootball, floorball).

family.title: Family
family.description: Always null: the sport has no score mapping.

home.title: Home
home.description: Headline score of the home side, as SofaScore displays it.

away.title: Away
away.description: Headline score of the away side, as SofaScore displays it.

PlainScore.title: PlainScore
PlainScore.description: The score of an event whose sport has no score family: only the headline score.

source.title: Source
source.description: `event`: the record derives from the stored `/event/{id}` payload. `listing`: the event is known only from a schedule page (a fixture, or a match whose details were never fetched); slices do not exist.

observed_at_utc.title: Observed At Utc
observed_at_utc.description: When the platform read the `/event/{id}` payload the record derives from. Null for a `listing` record and for a record stored by a version that did not note the time.

change_ts.title: Change Ts
change_ts.description: SofaScore's own time of its last change to the event. Carried as given; compare it for equality or order to detect a change.

settlement.title: Settlement
settlement.description: `open`: the event has not reached a terminal status, or has no `/event/{id}` payload. `provisional`: terminal status, but it was last read before start time plus the refresh window, so the result may still be corrected. `final`: it was read after the window closed (or the time of the read or the start time is unknown, or the refresh policy is off); the platform will not read it again by itself.

tier_hint.title: Tier Hint
tier_hint.description: True when SofaScore offers player statistics for the event or its tournament, which marks the better covered competitions (their results are corrected sooner). False when both flags are false, null when neither is given.

stale.title: Stale
stale.description: True when a schedule page read later than the event payload disagrees with it in status, winner, start time or a score field. The next refresh reads the event again.

status_regressed.title: Status Regressed
status_regressed.description: True when the event was stored as completed and a later read showed it as void.

Quality.title: Quality
Quality.description: How much the record can be trusted, and where it comes from.

event_ids.title: Event Ids
event_ids.description: Read `/event` of these events again, whether or not they are due (the Fetch again button). Not with `league_id`.

RefreshJobSpec.title: RefreshJobSpec
RefreshJobSpec.description: Without `event_ids`: the stored records that are due (of one tournament with `league_id`).

force.title: Force
force.description: Move the current data to the trash first (`.meta/trash/`); needed when the data directory is not empty. With `dry_run`: report what that would move.

dry_run.title: Dry Run
dry_run.description: True: only check (nothing is written). False: restore the backup.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the round, for example `Quarterfinals`. League rounds have none.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: The scheduler runs inside this server.

next_runs.title: Next Runs
next_runs.description: Empty when the scheduler is off.

ScheduleStatus.title: ScheduleStatus
ScheduleStatus.description: The in-app scheduler of this server (`ssc serve --scheduler`); off by default.

index.title: Index
index.description: Position of the task in the config file, from 1.

every.title: Every
every.description: The interval as written (`6h`); null for a cron task.

cron.title: Cron
cron.description: The cron expression (local time); null for an interval.

last_run_at_utc.title: Last Run At Utc
last_run_at_utc.description: When the task was last due; null before.

last_job_id.title: Last Job Id
last_job_id.description: The last job the task started.

last_result.title: Last Result
last_result.description: `skipped_running`: its previous run still ran; `skipped_busy`: another job or data operation held the data directory.

ScheduledRun.title: ScheduledRun
ScheduledRun.description: One task of the in-app scheduler (config file `[[schedule.task]]`) and its next run.

tournament_id.title: Tournament Id
tournament_id.description: Id of the Tournament the season belongs to.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the season, for example `Premier League 26/27`.

year.title: Year
year.description: The season's year text as SofaScore writes it: `26/27`, `2025`.

number.title: Number
number.description: Number of the set, starting at 1.

home.title: Home
home.description: Games the home side won in the set; points when the set is a match tie-break.

away.title: Away
away.description: Games the away side won in the set; points when the set is a match tie-break.

tiebreak.description: Points of the set's tie-break. Null when the set had none.

home.title: Home
home.description: Headline score of the home side: sets won.

away.title: Away
away.description: Headline score of the away side: sets won.

format.title: Format
format.description: What the score counts. `games`, `points`, `legs`: sets won, and each set counts games (tennis, padel), points (volleyball, badminton, table tennis) or legs (darts played in sets). `frames`, `legs_won`, `games_won`: no sets; `sets_won` and the headline score are the frames (snooker), legs (darts played in legs only) or games (e-sports) won. Null when the record has no score sheet.

sets.title: Sets
sets.description: The sets that have a score, in order.

match_tiebreak.title: Match Tiebreak
match_tiebreak.description: True when the deciding set was a match tie-break (first to 10 points) and not a normal set. A heuristic: the last of three or five sets has a side with 10 or more.

SetsScore.title: SetsScore
SetsScore.description: Score family `sets`: sets won and the score of each set. Tennis and padel count games per set; volleyball, badminton and table tennis count points; darts played in sets counts legs per set; snooker, darts played in legs only and e-sports give only the frames, legs or games won and no sets.

value.title: Value
value.description: The value in force. Secrets are masked.

source.title: Source
source.description: The layer the value comes from, weakest to strongest in this order.

source_name.title: Source Name
source_name.description: The file or the environment variable, when there is one.

locked.title: Locked
locked.description: Pinned by the config file, the environment or a flag: a change made here would have no effect.

writable.title: Writable
writable.description: Whether PATCH accepts this key right now.

type.title: Type
type.description: `rate`: requests per second, 0 or "off" for no limit; `seasons`: current, all, last:N or a list of season ids; `string_list`: a list of strings.

description.title: Description
description.description: What the setting does, in English.

minimum.title: Minimum
minimum.description: Lowest accepted value, when there is one.

exclusive_minimum.title: Exclusive Minimum
exclusive_minimum.description: The value must be above `minimum`, not equal to it.

maximum.title: Maximum
maximum.description: Highest accepted value, when there is one.

max_length.title: Max Length
max_length.description: Longest accepted text when changed through the API.

restart_needed.title: Restart Needed
restart_needed.description: A change takes effect only after `ssc serve` or `ssc watch` is started again.

SettingMetadata.title: SettingMetadata
SettingMetadata.description: How a setting can be changed (05-web-ui.md G4). One row per setting, in the order of `settings`.

config_file.title: Config File
config_file.description: Path of the config file in use, if any.

overrides_file.title: Overrides File
overrides_file.description: Path of the file PATCH has written, if any.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Type, limits, choices, section and restart need of each setting, in the order of `settings`.

slices.title: Slices
slices.description: Per-sport changes to the default slice selection ([slices.<sport>]), one row per registered sport in registry order. Change one with PATCH `{"values": {"slices.<sport>": {"enable": [...], "disable": [...]}}}`; null removes it.

values.title: Values
values.description: `section.key` to the new value; null removes the value written here earlier. `slices.<sport>` takes `{"enable": [...], "disable": [...]}`.

target.title: Target
target.description: The file path, or the webhook address with its credentials masked.

events.title: Events
events.description: Event type patterns the sink takes.

state.title: State
state.description: `pending`: the sink has delivered nothing yet; `error`: the last delivery failed.

served.title: Served
served.description: A process holds the `sinks` lease and delivers right now.

cursor.title: Cursor
cursor.description: Sequence number of the last event delivered to the sink.

head_seq.title: Head Seq
head_seq.description: Sequence number of the newest event of the log.

lag_events.title: Lag Events
lag_events.description: Events of the log after the cursor (all types, before the sink's filter).

lag_seconds.title: Lag Seconds
lag_seconds.description: Age of the oldest undelivered event; null when none.

dropped.title: Dropped
dropped.description: Undelivered events given up as too old, as far as the retained log tells.

SinkStatus.title: SinkStatus
SinkStatus.description: A configured output sink and how far it has delivered the event log.

owner_id.title: Owner Id
owner_id.description: Id of the owner; for `event` the event id.

key.title: Key
key.description: Name of the slice, for example `event`, `statistics`, `lineups`, `incidents`.

sub.title: Sub
sub.description: Sub-key for a slice that has several payloads per owner, for example the round of a schedule page. Null when the slice has one payload.

state.title: State
state.description: `ok`: a payload with data is stored. `empty`: SofaScore answered that it has no such data (404, or a response without content). `error`: the last attempt failed and it is unknown whether data exists. `not_requested`: the platform has not asked for it.

has_payload.title: Has Payload
has_payload.description: True when a payload is stored. A slice in state `error` can still hold the payload of an earlier successful read.

fetched_at_utc.title: Fetched At Utc
fetched_at_utc.description: When the stored payload was read.

checked_at_utc.title: Checked At Utc
checked_at_utc.description: When the slice was last asked for, whatever the outcome.

error.description: The last failure. Null unless the state is `error`.

payload.title: Payload
payload.description: The stored SofaScore response, unchanged (see Raw on request). Present only when asked for; null otherwise.

Slice.title: Slice
Slice.description: One stored response of SofaScore about an event or another entity, and its state.

http_status.title: Http Status
http_status.description: HTTP status of the failed response, when there was one.

count.title: Count
count.description: How many attempts in a row have failed.

SliceError.title: SliceError
SliceError.description: The last failed attempt to fetch a slice.

selected.title: Selected
selected.description: Slices selected for the event's sport and phase.

empty.title: Empty
empty.description: Selected slices SofaScore answered without data.

error.title: Error
error.description: Selected slices whose last request failed.

SliceSummary.title: SliceSummary
SliceSummary.description: How much of an event's selected data is stored.

i18n_key.title: I18N Key
i18n_key.description: Translation key of the name for clients.

slices.title: Slices
slices.description: Every slice that applies to the sport, disabled ones included.

path.title: Path
path.description: Path of the slice in SofaScore's API, with `{event_id}`.

required.title: Required
required.description: Counts for completeness in this sport: a match missing it is fetched again. False: requested when selected, but SofaScore does not always have it for this sport.

default_enabled.title: Default Enabled
default_enabled.description: Selected when no selection names it (the registry's default).

selected.title: Selected
selected.description: Selected by the configured defaults for this sport (`defaults.slices` and `slices.<sport>` of GET /settings); a follow can choose otherwise.

group.title: Group
group.description: Slice group; a selection can name the group instead of the key.

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: What the payload belongs to; one request per owner.

phases.title: Phases
phases.description: Match phases in which the slice can exist (before, during, after the match).

keep_history.title: Keep History
keep_history.description: Changed payloads are kept as a history (odds).

max_age_seconds.title: Max Age Seconds
max_age_seconds.description: Owner slices: fetched again when older than this; null = once.

enable.title: Enable
enable.description: Slice keys or groups added to `defaults.slices` for this sport.

disable.title: Disable
disable.description: Slice keys or groups removed for this sport (applied after `enable`).

source.title: Source
source.description: The layer the sport's selection comes from; `default` when none is set.

locked.title: Locked
locked.description: Pinned by the config file or the environment ([slices.<sport>]).

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the stage, for example `UEFA Champions League, Group A` or `Wimbledon, London, GB, Qualifying, 1st - 2nd Round`.

Stage.title: Stage
Stage.description: The part of a tournament an event belongs to: SofaScore's (non-unique) tournament object.

table.title: Table
table.description: Which table: `total` (all matches) or `home` (home matches only).

group_name.title: Group Name
group_name.description: Name of the table or group, for example `Premier League 26/27` or `Group A`.

position.title: Position
position.description: Rank in the table, 1 for the first.

draws.title: Draws
draws.description: Matches drawn; null in sports without draws.

points.title: Points
points.description: Table points (a fraction in a few sports).

StandingsRow.title: StandingsRow
StandingsRow.description: One row of a standings table of a season.

StartBackupJob.title: StartBackupJob
StartBackupJob.description: Write a backup zip into the data directory's `backups/`; download it through `/backups/{name}`.

StartClearJob.title: StartClearJob
StartClearJob.description: Delete stored data (follows, job history, change log, backups and exports stay).

StartExportJob.title: StartExportJob
StartExportJob.description: Write an export file into the data directory's `exports/`; download it through `/exports/{id}/download`.

StartFetchJob.title: StartFetchJob
StartFetchJob.description: Event details only, for the schedules that are already stored.

StartRebuildJob.title: StartRebuildJob
StartRebuildJob.description: Rebuild the catalog (`.meta/catalog.db`) from the stored files.

StartRefreshJob.title: StartRefreshJob
StartRefreshJob.description: Re-read the stored events that may still change.

StartRestoreJob.title: StartRestoreJob
StartRestoreJob.description:
Check what restoring a backup would do (`dry_run: true`, the Check step of the UI), or restore it
(`dry_run: false`, the Choose step). A restore replaces the data and the job history; this job stays in it.

StartSyncJob.title: StartSyncJob
StartSyncJob.description: Season lists, schedules and event details.

schema_version.title: Schema Version
schema_version.description: Version of the normalized schema of the records this API returns (`sofascore.data/<n>`).

auth_required.title: Auth Required
auth_required.description: Whether an access token is configured.

active_job.description: The job that runs on the data directory right now, in any process.

live.description: The live service; null when the store cannot be read.
